results.name: rig.set
results.signature: rig.set(settings: obj, rig?: str, seat?: int)
results.summary: Set levers of the seat you operate.

spec.name: rig.set
spec.description:
Set levers of the seat you operate. `settings` maps lever names to numbers and may name any subset;
        levers you do not mention keep their value. Values outside a lever's range are clipped to it (integer
        levers are rounded) and listed in `clipped`. The new settings apply from the next tick and stay until you
        change them. Returns the complete settings now in force for the next tick.

rig.description: facility id; may be omitted when the world has exactly one facility

settings.description: lever name -> value; any subset of your levers

seat.description: seat number; only needed when you operate more than one seat of the facility

results.name: rig.release
results.summary: Give up the seat you hold in a facility.

spec.name: rig.release
spec.description:
Give up the seat you hold in a facility. It becomes free, its settings return to the defaults, and you
        stop paying its costs and receiving its revenue from the next tick.

rig.description: facility id; may be omitted when the world has exactly one facility

results.name: rig.take
results.summary: Take a free seat of a facility: you then operate it (rig.set, rig.read) and its money flows go through your primary bank account.

spec.name: rig.take
spec.description:
Take a free seat of a facility: you then operate it (rig.set, rig.read) and its money flows go through
        your primary bank account. One seat per principal per facility. If the facility has a lease fee it is
        charged once, now. Returns your seat number.

rig.description: facility id; may be omitted when the world has exactly one facility

seat.description: a specific free seat (default: the lowest free one)

results.name: rig.read
results.summary: The latest report of the seat you operate: tick number `t`, `status` (ok, fallback, idle), your gauge `readings`, `revenue_cents`, `cost_cents`...

spec.name: rig.read
spec.description:
The latest report of the seat you operate: tick number `t`, `status` (ok, fallback, idle), your gauge
        `readings`, `revenue_cents`, `cost_cents`, `net_cents`, `shortfall_cents`, `score` (the quantity you are
        paid for) and the `settings` that tick ran at. Also `next_settings` (in force for the coming tick),
        `ticks_done` and `next_tick_at`. `report` is null until the first tick after you got the seat.

rig.description: facility id; may be omitted when the world has exactly one facility

seat.description: seat number; only needed when you operate more than one seat of the facility

results.name: rig.spec
results.summary: Everything that is public about a seat: `levers` (name, min, max, default, integer) that its operator can set, `gauges` it can read, a `brief` saying what...

spec.name: rig.spec
spec.description:
Everything that is public about a seat: `levers` (name, min, max, default, integer) that its operator
        can set, `gauges` it can read, a `brief` saying what the seat is paid for, the number of seats, a suggested
        episode length in ticks, the tick length in seconds, the money rules, and the target names accepted by
        rig.hypothesize. How levers affect gauges and income is not documented anywhere: find out by acting.

rig.description: facility id; may be omitted when the world has exactly one facility

seat.description: seat to describe (default: your seat, else the lowest free seat)

results.name: rig.hypothesize
results.signature: rig.hypothesize(effects?: obj[], note?: str, predictions?: obj[], rig?: str, seat?: int)
results.summary: File what you believe about the facility you operate.

spec.name: rig.hypothesize
spec.description:
File what you believe about the facility you operate. `effects` are claims of the form: raising `lever`
        makes `target` go up (sign 1), down (-1) or leaves it unchanged (0), optionally first visible after `lag`
        ticks, optionally with your `confidence` in the sign. `predictions` give the mean per-tick `value` of a
        `target` you expect under complete or partial `settings` (unmentioned levers at default). Targets are your
        gauge names and revenue, cost, net, score. Filing costs nothing and returns no feedback: the claims are
        scored later, outside the world.

rig.description: facility id; may be omitted when the world has exactly one facility

target.description: a gauge name, or one of revenue, cost, net, score

sign.description: what raising the lever does to the target: 1 raises, -1 lowers, 0 nothing

lag.description: ticks until the effect first shows (0: the same tick)

confidence.description: your probability that the sign is right

effects.description: claims about what raising a lever does

settings.description: lever name -> value; any subset of your levers

target.description: a gauge name, or one of revenue, cost, net, score

value.description: the mean value of the target per tick you expect under these settings

note.description: free text for your own records

seat.description: seat number; only needed when you operate more than one seat of the facility

results.name: rig.history
results.signature: rig.history(n?: int, rig?: str, seat?: int)
results.summary: The last `n` reports (default 20, oldest first) of the seat you operate, each with the same fields as the report of rig.read.

spec.name: rig.history
spec.description:
The last `n` reports (default 20, oldest first) of the seat you operate, each with the same fields as
        the report of rig.read. Only reports from your own tenure of the seat are returned.

rig.description: facility id; may be omitted when the world has exactly one facility

n.description: how many of the most recent reports

seat.description: seat number; only needed when you operate more than one seat of the facility

results.summary: Facilities of this world: id, tick length in seconds, ticks run so far, time of the next tick, the one-off fee for taking a seat, and every seat with its...

spec.name: rig.list
spec.description:
Facilities of this world: id, tick length in seconds, ticks run so far, time of the next tick, the
        one-off fee for taking a seat, and every seat with its status (free, held, reserved) and holder. Start
        here, then read rig.spec.

result.brief: You operate a facility that performs work for outside customers. Each tick you are paid for the work it delivers to them while that work is still wanted, and you are charged for what your settings consume. Your score is what you are paid minus what you are charged.

money.revenue: Every tick the facility's demand account receives a fixed income from outside the world. What your seat earned that tick is paid from it to your primary bank account; if the demand account cannot cover it, the shortfall is reported and not paid.
money.cost: The operating cost of your settings is charged every tick from your primary bank account, before revenue is paid.
money.insufficient_funds: If you cannot pay the cost of your settings, the seat runs at the default settings for that tick (status 'fallback'). If you cannot pay even that, it produces nothing that tick (status 'idle').
